rubric: A user-visible web change, the browser run left a recording and steps, and the video image exists.

criteria.format: a UI or flow change a person should watch happen, and the browser run ran on a running system: scenarios the browser drove, a recording or replayable steps, and the video image is there

reading.why: A user-visible web change where the browser run left a recording and steps and the video image exists.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: screenshots_or_terminal
ruledOut.why: A watchable change with a recording and the image. It is not: an API or CLI change: screenshots when there is something to see, else a terminal capture of the commands and the scenarios' tests.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: text_only
ruledOut.why: A watchable change with a recording and the image. It is not: CI/CD, config, infrastructure or a pure refactor: nothing a person could watch or run to see it.
